mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% triggers a risk premium adjustment that drives positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 0.3% in the current month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05) during confirmed inflation spikes, or CPIAUCSL does not exceed 0.3% in the trigger month.

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment momentum as measured by PAYEMS exceeds 200,000 monthly increases, signaling labor market strength that supports equity valuations and positive 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: Over 60-day horizon, SPX 20-day forward returns are negative or flat despite PAYEMS > 200,000, or unemployment rate (UNRATE) remains below 4.0% during the period.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in industrial production (INDPRO < 90) indicates weakening supply-side conditions, which tends to reduce corporate earnings expectations and produce negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO remains below 90 for at least 3 consecutive months without a subsequent SPX positive 20-day return, or IC > 0.05 over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in retail activity (HOUST) above 650K units suggests renewed consumer demand, which elevates equity risk premia and drives positive 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not positive when HOUST > 650K, or UNRATE > 4.0% during the period.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent tightening in credit conditions as reflected by FEDFUNDS above 4.5% produces a risk-off environment that depresses S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically negative (p > 0.05) during the tightening phase, or FEDFUNDS reverts below 4.5% within 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) combined with rising labor participation (PAYEMS) creates a labor market expansion signal associated with positive 60-day SPX forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (IC < 0.05) when both triggers are met, or UNRATE > 4.0% during the window.

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged decline in manufacturing activity (RSAFS < 350M) indicates supply-side weakness that persists for 3 months, producing negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: RSAFS recovers above 350M without a subsequent SPX positive 20-day return, or IC > 0.1 over the 20-day window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in FEDFUNDS accompanied by a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) suggests conflicting signals but the FEDFUNDS move dominates, leading to negative 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not negative when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and INDPRO < 95, or FEDFUNDS does not exceed 5.0% during the trigger.
